prompt: I need to scan a QR code with the camera, and also get the user's current location once (not a continuous stream) when the page loads. Which SDK modules do I use, and how do I avoid draining battery on the location call?
assertions: Uses CameraModule for QR code scanning
Addresses battery/resource conservation for a single location read — e.g. awaiting the stream method directly or unsubscribing promptly rather than leaving a subscription open indefinitely
